verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into the banner, not rearranged: the 'Read 2,400 Reviews' CTA label, the 'Maya R.' attribution and the Lumen & Fig logo are too small to read, though the quote, bottle-in-circle and reading order survive intact. B is jumbled: the quote mark floats mid-canvas after its own headline, the bottle is pulled away from its peach circle (which sits empty and cropped at the right edge), the CTA pill outweighs the quote, the headline wraps into four cramped lines, and the attribution is a tiny scrap beside the button.
